scripts.dev:app: concurrently "cd frontend && bun run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron electron/main.js"
scripts.build:win: concurrently "bun run build:backend" "bun run build:frontend" && bun run clean:dist-electron && electron-builder --win && bun run clean:after-package
scripts.dist:dir: concurrently "bun run build:backend" "bun run build:frontend" && bun run clean:dist-electron && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.test:stress: cd backend && uv run --project .. --locked --extra dev pytest ../tests/test_stress_conversion.py -v -m slow
scripts.bench:scalability: uv run --project . --locked --extra dev python scripts/scalability_baseline.py --scale 1x --output benchmarks/scalability-1x.json
scripts.lint:js: bun x oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json frontend/src electron shared scripts tests
scripts.lint:python: uv run --project . --locked --extra dev ruff check backend tests scripts
scripts.lint: bun run lint:js && bun run lint:python
scripts.lint:fix: bun x oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json --fix frontend/src electron shared scripts tests && uv run --project . --locked --extra dev ruff check backend tests scripts --fix
scripts.typecheck:frontend: cd frontend && bun check && bun check -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.typecheck:local: cd frontend && bun x tsrs --noEmit --fast && bun x tsrs --noEmit --fast -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.ci: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck:backend && bun run check:any && bun run check:ratchet && bun run audit:python && bun run audit:node && bun run typecheck:frontend && bun run check:budgets && bun test
